audience.text: Developers building .NET 8+ applications who need to generate, modify, and export Excel workbooks without requiring Microsoft Excel or native Office installations.

capabilities.text: Create new workbooks, add and rename worksheets, and manipulate cells with values, formulas, dates, and number formats.
capabilities.title: Create and edit workbooks

capabilities.text: Set fonts, colors, fills, borders, alignment, text wrapping, and cell locking via Style and Font objects.
capabilities.title: Apply rich cell styling

capabilities.text: Define validation rules and apply conditional formatting to cells using Validation and FormatCondition APIs.
capabilities.title: Configure data validation and conditional formatting

capabilities.text: Add hyperlinks, comments, pictures, and shapes to worksheets using dedicated collection and object types.
capabilities.title: Support hyperlinks, comments, and shapes

capabilities.text: Configure auto-filters, list objects (tables), and sort/filter conditions on worksheet data ranges.
capabilities.title: Apply filters and tables

capabilities.text: Export workbooks to PDF using PdfSaveOptions with configurable page setup and rendering options.
capabilities.title: Export to PDF

capabilities.text: Load corrupted .xlsx files with TryRepairPackage and TryRepairXml flags and inspect LoadDiagnostics for potential data loss.
capabilities.title: Repair malformed workbooks

limitations.text: Only .xlsx format is supported for loading and saving; other Excel formats like .xls are not supported.
The library stores formulas but does not include a formula calculation engine.
PDF export is supported, but there is no general HTML export or image export API.
Macros, VBA, and pivot tables are outside the supported public API surface.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic Excel workbook creation and modification in .NET without external dependencies like Microsoft Excel.
Supports loading malformed Excel files with repair options and diagnostic reporting to improve robustness.
Provides a consistent API surface for styling, formatting, and exporting workbooks to PDF across Windows, Linux, and macOS.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Cells FOSS for .NET is an MIT-licensed .NET 8+ library for creating, loading, editing, and saving Excel .xlsx workbooks and exporting them to PDF.

workflows.name: Create and save Excel workbook
workflows.text: Instantiate a Workbook, access a Worksheet, populate Cells with values and formulas, apply styles, and save to .xlsx format.

workflows.name: Load and repair malformed workbook
workflows.text: Use LoadOptions with repair flags to load a corrupted .xlsx file, inspect LoadDiagnostics for data loss risk, then save the repaired workbook.

workflows.name: Export workbook to PDF
workflows.text: Call Workbook.Save with PdfSaveOptions to convert the entire workbook or specific sheets to PDF format.
